record_title: Polar-wandering spectral projections for symmetric moduli in von Neumann algebras
provenance: Scientific sources and verification evidence are listed in RESULT.md and REVIEW.md.
limitations: A structural extension of recent finite-matrix symmetric-modulus inequalities. It does not claim new positive-block technology, does not establish a full generalized-singular-value theorem, does not treat arbitrary unbounded measurable operators, and the normalized center-valued half-dimension conclusion requires finiteness.
